notes.title: Game Balancing and Map Adjustment
notes.notes:
Even if it doesn't seem like it, I've made some adjustments that will modify and "facilitate" the game.
First of all, I added infinite checkpoints at the beginning of each new biome (regardless of the difficulty) and another one before the end.

Next, I modified how the penguin lands on the ground. In fact, its big feet tended to make it slide off platforms if it touched the edge. Now, its feet (and butt) have exceptional adhesive properties, and when it lands somewhere, it can no longer slide.

These modifications have led to changes in part of the final mountain (compared to the initial slippery sections).

I've also modified some parts of the level to make it less pixel-perfect.

With all this, I hope to see more speedruns :)

Pepper

notes.title: EASY MODE UPDATE
notes.notes:
I've added an easy mode to make the game more accessible and to better comprehend the game's 'true' difficulty mode. I hope more people will be able to discover my game thanks to this mode ! 
However, the easy mode won't allow you to obtain the true ending, even though it will let you play the game normally with all items to collect in the levels.

Feel free to let me know what you think :)

Pepper

notes.title: Summary of Minor Adjustments and Bug Fixes from the Last Few Days
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Even though the game has been out for a few days, I'm trying to be attentive to people's feedback (including streamers I watch on Twitch, hehe).
The downside of the game's development, and I only realize this now, is that there weren't enough beta testers. Now, I believe I have fixed the majority of issues, and I will be working on the multiplayer mode (although before that, I will make a small update that will allow you to [b]customize your penguin[/b]... it will be fun in multiplayer).
Since the release, here are some updates I've made:

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Drastically reduced the "sliding" effect on the character to make the game more manageable.
[*]Added input buffering on the jump. ([i]Basically, this means that if you press the jump button a little before touching the ground, you'll still jump when you hit the ground. It's much less frustrating this way, and who knows, it might allow for things that were almost impossible before?[/i])
[*]Made slight modifications to some traps, especially at the beginning of the game, which were a bit too difficult upon closer inspection. (specifically with the clouds, they will remain active a bit longer, and the buffering will help maintain your sanity).
[*]Fixed a bug in the options menu that selected the wrong language on the first launch of the game. There was also an issue with the selected quality not being the desired one; it should be good now.
[/list]
[b]Graphic[/b]
[list]
[*]The character's shadow will now always be displayed, regardless of the chosen graphics quality.
[*]Improved shadow effects for lower qualities to maintain an acceptable rendering (while saving performance) in the forest.
[/list]
